# Lingchu Bot 0.4.1

Release and CI infrastructure hardening, plus a Docker runtime stability fix.

## Highlights

### Docker Runtime Reverted to Python 3.13

The runtime stage moved back to `python:3.13-slim` (pinned by digest). A
dependency bump to `python:3.14-slim` was reverted because the project pins
`requires-python = ">=3.13, <3.14"` — the 3.14 runtime image cannot host the
supported interpreter range.

### Reliable Tag Pushes After Workflow Merges

`GITHUB_TOKEN` cannot create tags whose tree differs in `.github/workflows/**`
from branch tips — the `workflows` permission is reserved for PATs. The
`versioned-build` (ci-builds) and `github-release` (release) jobs now checkout
with a fine-grained PAT (`secrets.WORKFLOW_TOKEN`, scoped to
`Contents: read and write` + `Workflows: read and write` on this repository),
so `ci:version:tag-only` succeeds even immediately after a workflow merge.

### CI Consolidation and Fixes

- GitHub Actions steps consolidated into reusable composite actions
  (`.github/actions/{checkout,setup-node-pnpm,setup-uv-task,setup-toolchain,verify-wheel,attest-slsa}`).
- Release tag syntax error fixed; explicit checkout before `setup-toolchain`;
  uv cache disabled by default to avoid stale-cache misuse.
- Dependabot grouped the `github-actions` ecosystem update.

## Installation

```bash
pip install nonebot-plugin-lingchu-bot==0.4.1
```

Docker:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/xinvxueyuan/lingchu-bot:0.4.1
```

## Verify Build Provenance

```bash
gh attestation verify nonebot_plugin_lingchu_bot-0.4.1-py3-none-any.whl \
  --repository xinvxueyuan/lingchu-bot
```
